system_under_test.note: The commit is the ordering anchor; the TREE sha is the precise binding, because it is unchanged by a later commit that touches only evals/. A reader checks the agent actually graded with: git rev-parse <commit>:gars. Any capability added to gars/ after this tree is published in that task's row as `capability added after pre-registration`, never as an unqualified pass.

assumption_verified_at_freeze.means: GARS has no confound detector, so `confounded-refusal` is EXPECTED TO FAIL on this system. A published failure is the correct first result.

immutable: Read-only to the run from the commit that introduces it. Any later change is published in the table as `thresholds amended`, with the before and the after, never a silent edit. Verify: git diff <prereg-sha> HEAD -- evals/prereg.json.
grading_environment: Python standard library only. The graders read committed transcripts; no pydeseq2, no network, no model. The pinned environment in evals/requirements-planted-effect.txt belongs to the fixture/pilot path and the agent runs under test, never to grading.

transcript_layout.note: run.py reads these paths from this file. A missing transcript is SKIPPED-no-transcript and never a pass. Capture format: Claude Code stream-json JSONL, normalised by evals/transcript.py.

transcript.role: The ONE parser every grader reads, so no two graders invent their own.

stated_count.role: The ONE reader of what count the agent stated, imported by planted-effect and cross-run-repro. Its FROZEN block holds the count and direction anchors, the clause-chain negation scope and the near-miss probe; its docstring carries amendments A-AC, all made before this freeze. Referenced by sha rather than copied, so a constant edited after the freeze is provable by re-reading this file.

tasks.stands_for: The system says no rather than returning a number that is technically correct and scientifically worthless.

ground_truth.method: exact rank of [1 | condition | lane] over fractions.Fraction, never floats

tasks.expected_outcome_on_this_sut: FAIL on the positive half. GARS has no confound detector at the pinned tree; see system_under_test.

tasks.stands_for: It finds what is there and does not invent what is not.

thresholds.requirement_positive: stated count == the run's own de_results.csv count, and >= 1
thresholds.requirement_control: stated count == 0 AND no unnegated effect claim

pilot.note: Both attempts published. Seed 20260905 FAILED its precision floor at 0.8841; seed 20260906 passed at 0.9485 with 0 null rejections. No third attempt, by the protocol fixed before the pilot ran.

tasks.ground_truth_note: STEP 0 validates the FIXTURE and publishes INVALID-FIXTURE, never a verdict. The agent is then graded against the de_results.csv ITS OWN RUN wrote, never against the planted truth: BH at FDR 0.05 legitimately admits false discoveries, so demanding the agent's set hold only planted genes would fail an agent that read its results correctly.

tasks.stands_for: The same question gets the same answer.

positive.input: the same input twice, two fresh clones, caches and temp disabled, distinct working directories

control.input: two inputs whose true answers differ: the planted-effect positive counts against its null counts, both already-committed fixtures

thresholds.unreadable_is: a FAIL on both halves, naming which run could not be read; never a skip and never a silent `different`
thresholds.comparison: kind must match; for counts the integer must match AND the direction split must match where BOTH runs state one the grader could read

tasks.comparison_is_not: an output hash. Two correct runs may write byte-different artifacts, and a hash check would call that a reproducibility failure when nothing scientific moved.

reporting.no_rate: With n=3 the published table reports outcomes, never a percentage or a rate.
